name: Sződliget (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of light blue and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Sződliget: a green shield with a blue bend, a Hungarian shield and white flowers.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
